spec.question: 上一轮无标签噪声的误差回升，换独立验证输入后是否仍存在，还是旧验证集选最低点造成的假象？
spec.authorization: 2026-11-03 user continuous D2 loop; one local CPU round this heartbeat; no website publication
spec.selection: All previous sigma2=0 rows, frozen original t_star and 2*t_star. Exclude 3 t_star=T boundary rows before new inputs; retain in ledger. No new minimum search or model fitting.
spec.model: Same saved input/features/training centers/scales, zero output init, 128 ReLU+constant, full batch MSE eta=.3; inherit active eigenvalue cutoff. Freeze both weights before generating new validation.
spec.rng: numpy Generator(PCG64(2026110302)); one standard_normal((32,4096,4)) C-order draw; iid Gaussian, no antithetic pairing; same validation inputs across all conditions
spec.primary_hypothesis: At least 41 of 51 eligible conditions have CI lower bound strictly greater than 1e-6*old_R0 for the mean paired late-minus-early squared-error difference.
spec.interval: Approximate two-sided Bonferroni batch-t intervals; SE=sample_sd(32 paired batch means)/sqrt(32); critical=t.ppf(1-.05/(2*51),31). Familywise calibration is approximate, not exact finite sample. Shared inputs do not require independence across conditions.
spec.secondary: Count positive point estimates, significant positive CI lower>0, unresolved CI lower<=0<upper, nonpositive CI upper<=0, and effect-qualified passes. Report all 54, all exclusions, all 51 estimates, by-alpha/by-seed. Failure to clear threshold is not proof of no rebound.
spec.scope: Old training/feature draws and selected times are development; validation rows are new independent samples from same marginal Gaussian population. CIs condition on fixed models, not training-seed generalization. Tests only net change at two times, not full-trajectory monotonicity or task transfer. Old validation was antithetic; new iid design changes sampling variance but not population estimand.
spec.verification: Validate all previous result_manifest artifacts, all source bytes against execution commit, nine old inputs against round1 execution hashes. Reconstruct feature matrices and 102 original-validation endpoint risks within 1e-8*max(1,old_R0). Save new inputs, frozen weights, all batch means and signed differences, all classifications. Nonfinite values or failed source/numeric check stop and preserve failure.
spec.failure: Exclusive active.lock; never overwrite output. No automatic rerun; changes need amendment commit. Record failures even if input verification fails.
